summary: Codec-type dispatcher: runs a vtable-based precondition check via the object's vtable slot at +8; on non-zero (not ready) it returns -1. Otherwise it dispatches on the codec-type byte at this+0x2490: 1 -> CompressedAudioDecoder(a2), 2 -> TextureDecompression_1250(a2). An unknown type returns 0.

operations.description: Initialize the default result v3 to 0.
Indirect thiscall through the vtable pointer at this+0x0, invoking the function at vtable offset +8 as a precondition check on this.
Return -1 when the vtable precondition check returns non-zero (decoder not ready).
Guard: codec-type byte at this+0x2490 equals 1 (audio codec).
Dispatch to CompressedAudioDecoder(a2) for codec type 1.
Guard: codec-type byte at this+0x2490 equals 2 (texture codec).
Dispatch to TextureDecompression_1250(a2) for codec type 2.
Return the default result 0 when the codec type matches neither 1 nor 2.

unresolved: The object class and the exact precondition checked by the vtable slot at +8 are unknown; owner stays UnknownObject.
Meaning of a2 (input data pointer/size) depends on the caller MPEGBuffer context.
